content.text: Perfect! Now let me generate checksums for the output file and create a comprehensive manifest:

input.command: cd /mnt/user-data/outputs && sha256sum met_inventory_standardized.tsv > met_inventory_standardized.sha256 && md5sum met_inventory_standardized.tsv > met_inventory_standardized.md5 && echo "=== OUTPUT FILE CHECKSUMS ===" && cat met_inventory_standardized.sha256 && cat met_inventory_standardized.md5
input.description: Generate checksums for the standardized output file
